'''2011 Minnesota State Championship Matt Scott LS Kashyyyk''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Matt Scott]] at [[2011 Minnesota State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Kashyyyk|ANH-L-kashyyyk.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Pied Piper
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
